name: Adaptive Octree Generation with Flatness Criterion
definition: Generates an adaptive octree for isosurface extraction by refining nodes based on surface intersection flatness, assigning vertex values via Euclidean distance transform sampling.
summary: Adaptive Octree Generation with Flatness Criterion creates spatial subdivisions for isosurface extraction by recursively refining nodes based on curvature-to-area ratios, ensuring high density in curved regions while keeping flat areas coarse.
